properties.name: axon.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-delimited list of host:port pairs to use for establishing the initial connection to the Kafka cluster.

properties.name: axon.kafka.client-id
properties.description: Id to pass to the server when making requests; used for server-side logging.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.auto-commit-interval
properties.description: Frequency in milliseconds that the consumer offsets are auto-committed to Kafka if 'enable.auto.commit' true.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.auto-offset-reset
properties.description: What to do when there is no initial offset in Kafka or if the current offset does not exist any more on the server.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-delimited list of host:port pairs to use for establishing the initial connection to the Kafka cluster.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.client-id
properties.description: Id to pass to the server when making requests; used for server-side logging.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.enable-auto-commit
properties.description: If true the consumer's offset will be periodically committed in the background.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.event-processor-mode
properties.description: Controls the default message source type which will be responsible for consuming records from Kafka and providing them to an Event Processor. Defaults to {@link EventProcessorMode#TRACKING}, which will instantiate a {@link org.axonframework.extensions.kafka.eventhandling.consumer.streamable.StreamableKafkaMessageSource}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.fetch-max-wait
properties.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds the server will block before answering the fetch request if there isn't sufficient data to immediately satisfy the requirement given by "fetch.min.bytes".

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.fetch-min-size
properties.description: Minimum amount of data the server should return for a fetch request in bytes.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Expected time in milliseconds between heartbeats to the consumer coordinator.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.key-deserializer
properties.description: Deserializer class for keys. Defaults to a {@link StringDeserializer}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.max-poll-records
properties.description: Maximum number of records returned in a single call to poll().

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.properties
properties.description: Additional consumer-specific properties used to configure the client.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.ssl.key-password
properties.description: Password of the private key in the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.ssl.keystore-location
properties.description: Location of the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.ssl.keystore-password
properties.description: Store password for the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.ssl.truststore-location
properties.description: Location of the trust store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.ssl.truststore-password
properties.description: Store password for the trust store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.consumer.value-deserializer
properties.description: Deserializer class for values. Defaults to a {@link ByteArrayDeserializer}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.default-topic
properties.description: Default topic to which messages will be sent. Defaults to a topic called {@code "Axon.Events"}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.fetcher.buffer-size
properties.description: Size of the buffer containing fetched Kafka records to be transferred over in to Axon Event Messages. Will only be used for a {@link org.axonframework.extensions.kafka.eventhandling.consumer.streamable.StreamableKafkaMessageSource} instance. Defaults to {@code 10.000} records.

properties.name: axon.kafka.fetcher.enabled
properties.description: Enables auto-configuration for consuming events from Kafka. Defaults to {@code true}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.fetcher.poll-timeout
properties.description: The time, in milliseconds, spent waiting in poll if data is not available in the buffer. If 0, returns immediately with any records that are available currently in the buffer, else returns empty. Must not be negative and defaults to {@code 5000} milliseconds. @see KafkaConsumer#poll(Duration)

properties.name: axon.kafka.message-converter-mode
properties.description: Converter mode to use, can be 'default' or 'cloud_event'.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.acks
properties.description: Number of acknowledgments the producer requires the leader to have received before considering a request complete.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.batch-size
properties.description: Number of records to batch before sending.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-delimited list of host:port pairs to use for establishing the initial connection to the Kafka cluster.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.buffer-memory
properties.description: Total bytes of memory the producer can use to buffer records waiting to be sent to the server.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.client-id
properties.description: Id to pass to the server when making requests; used for server-side logging.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.compression-type
properties.description: Compression type for all data generated by the producer.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.event-processor-mode
properties.description:
Controls the mode of event processor responsible for sending messages to Kafka. Depending on this, different error handling behaviours are taken in case of any errors during Kafka publishing.

Defaults to {@link EventProcessorMode#SUBSCRIBING}, using a {@link org.axonframework.eventhandling.SubscribingEventProcessor} to publish events.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.key-serializer
properties.description: Serializer class for keys. Defaults to a {@link StringSerializer}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.properties
properties.description: Additional producer-specific properties used to configure the client.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.retries
properties.description: When greater than zero, enables retrying of failed sends.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.ssl.key-password
properties.description: Password of the private key in the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.ssl.keystore-location
properties.description: Location of the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.ssl.keystore-password
properties.description: Store password for the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.ssl.truststore-location
properties.description: Location of the trust store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.ssl.truststore-password
properties.description: Store password for the trust store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.transaction-id-prefix
properties.description: When non empty, enables transaction support for producer.

properties.name: axon.kafka.producer.value-serializer
properties.description: Serializer class for values. Defaults to a {@link ByteArraySerializer}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.properties
properties.description: Additional properties, common to producers and consumers, used to configure the client.

properties.name: axon.kafka.publisher.ack-timeout
properties.description: The publisher acknowledge timeout in milliseconds specifying how long to wait for a publisher to acknowledge a message has been sent. Defaults to {@code 1000} milliseconds.

properties.name: axon.kafka.publisher.confirmation-mode
properties.description: The confirmation mode used when publishing messages. Defaults to {@link ConfirmationMode#NONE}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.publisher.enabled
properties.description: Enables auto-configuration for publishing events to Kafka. Defaults to {@code true}.

properties.name: axon.kafka.publisher.processing-group
properties.description: The Kafka Event Handler processing group. Defaults to {@code "__axon-kafka-event-publishing-group"}

properties.name: axon.kafka.ssl.key-password
properties.description: Password of the private key in the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.ssl.keystore-location
properties.description: Location of the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.ssl.keystore-password
properties.description: Store password for the key store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.ssl.truststore-location
properties.description: Location of the trust store file.

properties.name: axon.kafka.ssl.truststore-password
properties.description: Store password for the trust store file.
